description.value: Cap's Bicycles is a full-service bike shop in Langley carrying Norco, Kona, Opus, and Devinci across mountain, gravel, city, e-bike, and kids categories. Their service department employs professionally trained technicians offering everything from basic tune-ups to complete frame-up rebuilds, including dedicated e-bike service packages. A large in-store parts inventory spanning drivetrains, brakes, cables, and components makes it a practical stop for cyclists in the Fraser Valley.

address.value: Unit B140, 6286 203 Street, Langley, BC V3A 5E6

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and corroborates the OSM address, phone, and URL. The service page explicitly lists e-bike-specific tune-up packages and states that professionally trained technicians will assess bikes and provide estimates, supporting staff help with mechanicals and walk-in repair service. No mention of pump availability, rentals, bike boxes, washrooms, or most other optional amenities, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM name 'CAP'S Bicycles' uses all-caps 'CAP'S'; website consistently renders it as 'Cap's Bicycles' — minor capitalization discrepancy.
OSM opening_hours (Tu-Sa 09:30-17:30) omits Sunday hours that the website lists (Sun 11:00am–5:00pm); OSM record appears incomplete.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Established full-service bike shop with professional mechanics, e-bike service, and a large parts inventory — a clear benefit to touring cyclists moving through the Fraser Valley.

E-bike service.detail: Service page lists dedicated 'Comp Tune-Up (Hub Drive E-Bikes)' and 'Comp Plus Tune-Up (Hub Drive E-Bikes)' packages with specific e-bike service tasks

wow_evidence: professionally trained technicians offering everything from basic tune-ups to complete frame-up rebuilds
